# Electronic Theses of LMU Munich

> Open access institutional repository for electronic dissertations and theses from Ludwig-Maximilians-Universität München, powered by EPrints platform.

edoc.ub.uni-muenchen.de is LMU Munich's official digital repository for doctoral theses and dissertations, providing open access publishing and discovery services. The platform supports the Berlin Declaration on Open Access and enables researchers to browse, search, and deposit academic work across multiple disciplines.

## Browse & Discover

- [Browse Items](https://edoc.ub.uni-muenchen.de/view): Browse and search thesis items in LMU Munich's EPrints digital repository
- [Browse by faculties](https://edoc.ub.uni-muenchen.de/view/subjects/index.html): Browse LMU theses by faculty and subject classification in EPrints
- [Browse by subjects](https://edoc.ub.uni-muenchen.de/view/ddc): Browse LMU theses using Dewey Decimal Classification system
- [Browse by authors](https://edoc.ub.uni-muenchen.de/view/autoren/index.html): Alphabetical directory of thesis authors in LMU repository
- [Browse by first referees](https://edoc.ub.uni-muenchen.de/view/gutachter/index.html): Directory of dissertation advisors and referees at LMU Munich
